title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements
summary: Hold: the governance prose overstates the absence of controls by saying nothing documented switches off or restricts the new targeting. Microsoft documents an existing restriction on who can create storyline posts; the absence should be limited to a separate targeting control. The roadmap dates, notification licensing and listed administration paths are supported.

Existing creator restrictions at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/engage/eac-storyline do restrict who can create the posts; the absence must concern a separate targeting control, not controls generally.
